text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"All right, let's do this! With the 
Academy's support, our preparations are 
complete!\nSince this is everyone's first 
time playing karuta, let's start with the 
rules..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Umamusume Karuta is a 4-on-4 team battle. 
Just like regular Hyakunin Isshu, the 
first half of a poem is read aloud, and 
you must grab the corresponding card with 
the second half!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"The differences are the size of the 
cards, and... 
that you have to run to grab them... 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"That's right! Running all over the place, 
sometimes even bumping into each other... 
That's why 'Umamusume Karuta' is called a 
martial art for the literary-minded!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Our four-person team will be split into 
'Callers' and 'Takers.' 
Essentially, one person finds the card 
that was read, and the other runs to grab 
it."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... Then as the supreme commander, I, 
TM Opera O, 
shall take on the role of 'Caller.' Are 
you ready, Doto?!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes, ma'am...! S-So I'm the 'Taker,' 
right...? I-I'll do my best!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, let's pair up, Urara-san. 
Could you be the 'Caller,' please??"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "All right, I'll do my best!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I'm sure there are other detailed 
rules, but I'm not overly 
familiar with them either. Practice makes 
perfect, so let's just try it together!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"For now, let's leave the reading to the 
app, and... there. 
We have such convenient tools these days~. 
Here we go—"

text_block_list.name: Text-to-Speech Voice
text_block_list.text:
"'—Now spring has come, and blossoms 
bloom. 
Run forth, Umamusume—'"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"All right, onward, Doto! Ride forth on 
golden wings! 
Head south! The second one from the 
right!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Eek! S-South?! ...This way?! No, that 
way?! 
Hauuu~, wh-which way is it?!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "Hmm, what should I be looking for?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Urara-san! It's 'Upon Negishi's hill'! 
Please look for 'Ne'~!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"'Ne'... 
'Ne'... Found it! Over there, Fuku-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Where is 'over there'?! That's a bit too 
vague!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Fueee, which way is south?! 
I-I-If I remember right, the morning sun 
was over there, so—"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa-whoa-whoa, are you lost, Doto-san?! 
Please run in a straight line~, it's 
dangerous!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? There are two 'Ne's. 
Hey, Fuku-chan, which one should I take?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Gwahhh?! Urara-san, 
it's the one with 'gi' right after 'ne'~!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Eh, 'gi'? Then it's not this one—wait, 
whaaa?! M-My legs are getting tangled...!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Hyawa! Doto-san, why did you make such a 
sharp turn—whoaaaa?!"

text_block_list.name: Doto & Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "Owww!!!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "Well! That was refreshingly disastrous!!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh... I'm so sorry, it's all because I'm 
so hopeless..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, it's not your fault at all, 
Doto-san! 
We're all beginners at this anyway~!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"But... if only I hadn't tripped, I 
wouldn't have dragged you down with me, 
Fukukitaru-san..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine, really! 
I know very well that you didn't do it on 
purpose."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Besides... have you forgotten? Lord 
Shiraoki's divine message said, 
'Joining forces with your companions to 
face a contest brings Great, Great 
Fortune'!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"In other words, as long as we all 
participate in the karuta tournament 
together, 
winning or losing has nothing to do with 
improving our luck!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"B-But... is that really what joining 
forces means...?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Of course! Even Lord Shiraoki wouldn't 
demand 
that complete amateurs go and win right 
off the bat."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"If we all take part and have fun, we'll 
become closer and everyone will be happy! 
That must be what the divine message 
really meant!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "I-I see...?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, but falling over really isn't good. 
It's dangerous for our opponents too... 
I really need to practice properly..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Come now, there's no need to look so 
stressed. 
Fortune comes to those who smile!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Nay, however... there are times when 
training is indeed necessary! 
I, your supreme commander, TM Opera O, ask 
of you—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Is this the pose befitting a supreme 
commander?! 
Or perhaps... this one?!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Wow, that looks so cool! I wanna do it 
too!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh, looking sharp! 
Well, since we're at it, how about 
something like this?!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"(Everyone's... so full of energy... 
Ugh... I need to practice hard so I don't 
mess up, too...!)"
